subtitle: Wind-up toys vs dust bunnies
description:
Tintrot is a quick lane defense game played with tin wind-up toys. A cat is napping on the rug, and dust bunnies keep rolling out from under the bed, down the floorboards, toward it. Press and hold a floorboard to wind a toy, let go, and it trots up the board and shoves the fluff back under the bed.

How much you wind is how hard the toy pushes. A small fluff needs a quick twist; a big shaggy hairball needs a full spring. But you only have one key, and while you wind one toy the other boards keep rolling. Let go just before the spring is full for a snug wind and an extra-strong shove. Hold too long and the spring snaps.

Dust bunnies pick up fluff as they roll, so an early shove is cheaper. Wait for a board to line up, though, and one toy can bonk two or three bunnies in a row for a much bigger score. A tin mouse, a tin duck and a sturdy tin elephant take turns in your tray, and you can always see which two are coming next.

New boards open, socks come sliding and tangles split in two as the afternoon goes on. Let three bunnies reach the rug and the cat wakes up. Keep it napping and chase your best score.

Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Hold to wind a tin toy, let go to send it trotting. Shove the dust bunnies back under the bed before they wake the napping cat.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Press and hold on a floorboard to wind a tin toy, then let go to send it up the board to shove the dust bunnies back under the bed. The game ends when 3 dust bunnies reach the sleeping cat, or when toys sent up empty boards clank too often and wake it.
